Professional Role & Output.question: Has the candidate held formal research/teaching positions and produced peer-reviewed publications, or have their contributions been primarily through coursework and personal/academic projects?

Primary Technical Methodology.question: Is the candidate's core technical expertise centered on machine learning implementation (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) versus mathematical modeling and experimental biophysics (e.g., COMSOL, microscopy, microfluidics)?

Academic Leadership Experience.question: Has the candidate supervised graduate students or led research teams in an academic/professional setting?

Project Portfolio Focus.question: Does the candidate's project portfolio consist primarily of deployed software applications (e.g., web apps, APIs) with clear business/engineering logic, rather than academic research and data analysis projects?

Technical Project Leadership.question: Has the candidate led the development of a deployed, team-based technical project (e.g., a hackathon-winning application) from concept to implementation?

Industry-Specific Technical Skills.question: Does the candidate demonstrate direct, hands-on experience with industry-specific tools and platforms (e.g., Bloomberg Terminal, KNIME, Azure) relevant to the target role?

Multimodal System Development.question: Has the candidate built and integrated end-to-end multimodal (e.g., visual + audio) data analysis systems?

Robotics & SLAM Expertise.question: Does the candidate have hands-on experience with robotics software (e.g., ROS, Gazebo) and SLAM algorithm benchmarking?

Project Scope and Autonomy.question: Does the candidate's project experience demonstrate leading research initiatives or implementing defined business solutions?

Technical Experience Depth.question: Can the candidate demonstrate hands-on experience with a wide range of advanced ML tasks (e.g., model quantization, edge deployment, LLM training) beyond basic model building?

Advanced Research Experience.question: Has the candidate conducted and published original research involving fine-tuning LLMs for a specific, complex application?

Professional Work Tenure.question: Does the candidate have over a year of professional, non-internship experience in a role directly applying their technical skills?

Industry-Specific Technical Experience.question: Does the candidate have hands-on project or internship experience in a specific, mature industry (e.g., power systems, electrical engineering)?

Academic Teaching Appointment.question: Does the candidate hold a formal, ongoing faculty position (e.g., Associate Professor) at a university?
